items.title: Waters (WAT) Launches Xevo TQ Absolute XR IVD For Clinical Labs
items.summary: Waters (NYSE: WAT) introduced the Xevo TQ Absolute XR IVD Mass Spectrometer, a new clinical laboratory system with high analytical sensitivity and robustness. The instrument targets critical clinical applications, including hormone testing and toxicology workflows. The launch expands Waters' clinical diagnostics product lineup at a time when demand for precise mass spectrometry tools in healthcare remains a key focus for laboratories.
